output_list.code: function mintToken(uint256 _amount) { if (msg.sender == owner) { totalSupply += _amount; balances[owner] += _amount; Transfer(0, owner, _amount); } }
output_list.reason: The mintToken function allows anyone to mint new tokens, which will devalue the token. The totalSupply will be increased and the balance of the owner will be increased. This will make the token more valuable than it should be.
